subject: Basket star
topic: This tangle of curling arms is a single animal.
script:
This tangle of curling arms is a single animal.
It's a basket star, a relative of sea stars.
Each of its arms splits again and again, into countless tiny branches.
In a current, it spreads them out like a living net.
When small animals drift into the net, the arms curl up and trap them.
Then it passes the food along to its mouth, hidden in the middle.
This one was filmed in deep water off Indonesia, in twenty ten.
And it wasn't alone. Several large shrimp were living among its arms.
In the deep sea, even a sea star can become an apartment building.
How many arms do you think it has?
